# The amendment history — what the rules said, and when it changed

**GENERATED FILE — do not hand-edit.** Written by `corepack pnpm rules:history`
(`scripts/amendment-history.mjs`) from `git log -p` over `CLAUDE.md` and
`docs/rulings.md`. It is derived rather than composed, so it cannot become a
session's account of the rules instead of the rules' own record.

Generated 2026-08-20 (America/Phoenix, from `pnpm stamp`).

Newest first. An entry is a commit that opened or reworded a rule.

**28 commits changed a rule**, out of 33 that touched either file. 33 diffs were read.

`CLAUDE.md` is LAW: a rule there binds every session and is changed only by
Sean. `docs/rulings.md` is the append-only record of decisions that are not
law. A ruling that becomes law is written into `CLAUDE.md` and its entry says
so; a ruling that contradicts `CLAUDE.md` does not silently win — the conflict
is named and Sean rules.

---
